title: Launch hero: claim, drop, product on the kick

beats.role: the claim as full-bleed type, 3 words
the product enters on the drop
one figure lands as the proof
escalate the claim, new words, same scale
one UI detail, on the beat

rules: Full-bleed display type: 3 words max per beat, no paragraph copy.
One emphasis per beat: a word changes size, never colour.
Arabic keeps letterSpacing 0 and no text-transform; the size is the drama.

reference.move: Open on the claim, cut the product in on the drop, hold the end card.
reference.note: Pattern adapted from the launch films catalogued on whatships.com; the anatomy only, no frames or prompts reused.

guardrails: No metric, rating or countdown the product cannot repeat.
The end card holds long enough to read the handle twice.
